quote: Jacobs offers exceptional resources and a strong commitment to developing its people. The company emphasizes implementing plant improvements correctly and prioritizing long-term performance and reliability over lowest initial cost. Jacobs is also open to innovative approaches, such as partnering with machine-learning organizations to develop data-driven algorithms that reduce chemical consumption. This approach is why I am proud to be a part of Jacobs' team.
speaker: Richard Piovoso
title: Union Lead Operator
